text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Overcoming the 3,000-meter trial, a<n>blistering gale
snatches victory from<n>the flower of famed lineage
and<n>brings the Triple Crown tour to a<n>splendid close!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: It's Ines Fujin! Ines Fujin has<n>triumphed!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
You're amazing, Ines! That was<n>some incredible
racing!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Pant... pant...

I carry Ines Fujin to the waiting room.<n>She
undergoes a brief examination,<n>but the doctor tells
me she's<n>perfectly fine.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Where... am I?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Oh. I collapsed again, huh?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...This is pathetic. I've caused so<n>much trouble and
made everyone<n>worry.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I thought I could pull it together. And<n>my sisters
were watching too... This<n>means I—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: N-no, nothing like that! It's just, you<n>know...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
There was that whole mess before<n>the race, and
then I went and passed<n>out, so I... I'm just really
sorry!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I'm okay, though. I am. I won't mess<n>up ever
again! No matter what!

Ines Fujin may insist that she's fine<n>now, but she
certainly doesn't look it.
choice_data_list: I want you to tell me if something happened.
I want you to tell me if something happened.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
No, it's fine. Nothing happened at all.<n>I'm fine.
Totally fine...
choice_data_list: What matters to you matters to me, too.
What matters to you matters to me, too.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...! B-but... it's like...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I can't take care of the things that are<n>important to
me!
Her eyes well up like a dam about to<n>burst.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Last time I visited home... I found out<n>something that
shocked me.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
My sisters quit their dance lessons<n>so they could
help out around the<n>house.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Our mom gets sick a lot. And she's<n>been going
through another bad spell<n>lately, so she's in and
out of hospital.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
My sisters said they're going to take<n>care of her in
my place, since I can't<n>be there right now.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
This is all because I left home to<n>satisfy my own
selfish desire to<n>race...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Why did you two give up dancing?! I<n>can just quit
racing and come home.<n>That will solve everything!

text_block_list.name: Little Sister A
text_block_list.text:
You're wrong! You don't get it, Big<n>Sis! Just go
back to the academy<n>already!

text_block_list.name: Little Sister A
text_block_list.text:
I won't forgive you if you quit racing<n>to stay at
home! I'll never talk to you<n>again!

text_block_list.name: Little Sister A
text_block_list.text:
This is something me and Polly set<n>our minds on! If
you go and quit<n>racing now, then...

text_block_list.name: Ines's Father
text_block_list.text: Sigh. We all discussed this, and wewant you to pursue your dream. Sothere's no need to worry about us.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
So... you two will be happy as long as<n>I don't give
up on running?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
But you don't need to handle<n>everything
yourselves. There are<n>plenty of housekeeping
services<n>these days, and I could pay for it with<n>my
wages.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
So please don't let go of your<n>dreams... Promise me
that one thing!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I worked all I could to send moremoney home, but that just madethem more worried that I'd end up ruining my health.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to put their minds at ease, to<n>show them I
wasn't overdoing it. I<n>even changed my running
style in an<n>attempt to blow away all their worries.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
That's why I didn't want them to see<n>me collapse
after the Kikuka Sho...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: If things keep going like this, then...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ah, I'm sorry! I guess it's not really<n>that big a deal!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
It is what it is, you know? Besides,<n>I'm sure girls
born into prestigious<n>families are under a lot more
pressure than I am.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
It kind of feels like I should be doing<n>all this
bellyaching about race-related<n>stuff, huh? Like a
major injury or<n>something.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry for burdening you with<n>something so
trivial. It's a family<n>matter, so there's no need for
you to<n>worry about it.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
choice_data_list: It's an important issue for you, right?
It's an important issue for you, right?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
choice_data_list: I won't let you shoulder this alone.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Sniffle... Waaaaah! Sob, sob...

The tears that had been filling Ines<n>Fujin's eyes
finally begin to<n>overflow.

Her shoulders tremble as she sobs. I<n>gently put my
arm around her in an<n>offer of support.

Once she eventually calms down, we<n>talk about
what her next step should<n>be.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: The next step, huh?
choice_data_list: How about taking a bit of a break?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, that might be a good idea.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I'd like that. A short one. Just until I<n>figure out how
to handle my situation.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
As for my next major goal... Would it<n>be all right to
choose something far<n>off? Say, early spring?

The Osaka Hai is a G1 race held in<n>spring. At 2,000
meters on turf, the<n>distance shouldn't pose an
issue.<n>It's even held at Hanshin<n>Racecourse, just
like the Asahi Hai<n>F.S.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: That sounds good. I think I can handle<n>it.

A few days after the Kikuka Sho, I<n>make a phone
call that I believe will<n>be important in supporting
Ines Fujin<n>going forward.
Brrring, brrring...

text_block_list.name: Ines's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Hello, is this Ines's trainer? Thank<n>you for always
looking out for my<n>daughter.
choice_data_list: It's been nothing but a pleasure.

text_block_list.name: Ines's Mother
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry we haven't had many<n>opportunities to
speak on the phone<n>like this. Are you calling about
the<n>matter we discussed previously?

text_block_list.name: Ines's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I have a request of my own.<n>I hesitate to
ask considering the<n>situation, but regarding the
Arima<n>Kinen...
